delta_metrics.rejection_basis: Both de-risking variants improved only old_thin while cutting late_strong and mid_weak EV/return. The apparent residual loss cluster was not stable enough to justify a broad commodity trend haircut.

hypothesis: After the accepted A+B residual allocation stack, repeated SLV/IAU stop-outs may indicate that `trend_long | Commodities` is a distinct residual allocation leak, separate from the accepted low-TQS commodity breakout exemption.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM soft ranking remains blocked by candidate-level replay coverage, so this deterministic residual allocation probe deliberately avoided LLM responsibilities.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: slow-melt bull where commodity trend exposure contained large winners despite one SLV stop
market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where commodity trend still had positive net contribution despite SLV/IAU losses
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak tape where one SLV trend loss made the broad cut look attractive

next_retry_requires: Do not retry broad trend_long Commodities de-risking without a new discriminator that preserves late/mid winners
Do not confuse this with the accepted low-TQS commodity breakout exemption; this failed probe was trend-only
If commodity residual work returns, require cross-asset or trade-specific context rather than a broad strategy+sector haircut
notes: This was alpha_search, not bug repair. It changes one tested causal variable in runtime only: a broad commodity trend risk multiplier.
